biotools.summary: FijiFISH is an ImageJ-based plugin enabling image registration, cell segmentation, and gene expression quantification for multiplexed fluorescence in situ hybridization (mFISH) data analysis. It's part of the Fiji distribution of ImageJ, a widely used open-source image processing platform.
